repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Reach 是面向 AI Agent 的开源 CLI 工具，一键赋予全网阅读与搜索能力。它零 API 费用，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，有效解决网页访问限制、平台封锁与付费 API 痛点。基于 Python，跨平台部署，显著降低 AI 与互联网交互门槛。
repos.summary_en: Agent Reach is an open-source CLI tool for AI agents, enabling one-click internet reading and searching. With zero API fees, it supports Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, addressing web access limits, platform blocks, and paid API issues. Python-based and cross-platform, it significantly lowers the barrier for AI-web interaction.

repos.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署
repos.summary_zh: IPTV-API是一款功能全面的IPTV直播源自动化采集与管理工具，支持多源聚合、智能校验测速及自定义频道，输出M3U、TXT及API，支持CLI、GUI和Docker多端部署。
repos.summary_en: IPTV-API is a comprehensive automated tool for IPTV live stream collection, validation, and speed testing. It aggregates sources, filters high-quality channels, and outputs customized playlists in M3U, TXT, or API formats. With support for IPv4/IPv6, Docker, CLI, and GUI, it provides a robust solution for seamless live TV playback.

repos.description: 🚀 抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，自托管，支持 MCP 调用与 Docker 一键部署。| Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console for posts, profiles, comments and playlists. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up.
repos.summary_zh: 自托管的抖音与TikTok数据采集及无水印下载API，支持Docker一键部署、REST API与MCP。集成自愈身份池与PostgreSQL存档，提供CLI和Web控制台，适用于高效抓取与内容归档。
repos.summary_en: This self-hosted, open-source solution provides a powerful API for scraping Douyin and TikTok, delivering clean, watermark-free video and image downloads directly from platform sources. Easily deployable via Docker Compose, it features an async REST API, MCP integration, CLI, and an intuitive web console. Leveraging a self-healing identity pool and robust PostgreSQL archiving, it supports comprehensive data extraction for posts, profiles, comments, and search queries, ideal for developers seeking reliable, large-scale social media data collection and automated workflow integration.

repos.description: 收集免费的接口服务,做一个api的搬运工
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库系统整理了大量免费、实用的Web API接口，涵盖加密算法、天气查询、AI大模型、生活服务等多个领域，每月定时更新。核心价值在于为开发者提供便捷的API集成方案，降低开发成本，加速项目迭代，是开发者快速获取免费接口资源的实用工具库。
repos.summary_en: This repository systematically collects a wide range of free and practical Web APIs, covering encryption, weather, AI models, and daily services, with monthly updates. It provides developers with a convenient API integration solution, reducing development costs and accelerating project iteration, serving as a practical toolkit for quickly accessing free API resources.

repos.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv
repos.summary_zh: PanSou是一款高性能网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件并发搜索。采用工作池设计，实现多源并发与智能排序，自动分类网盘类型。内置异步插件系统与二级缓存，提升搜索效率。Docker一键部署，开箱即用，适用于学习研究。
repos.summary_en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage resource search API service that supports concurrent searches across Telegram channels and custom plugins. It features a worker pool design for multi-source concurrency, intelligent sorting, and automatic categorization of cloud drive types. With an asynchronous plugin system and two-level caching, it significantly improves search efficiency. Docker deployment enables one-click setup, ideal for research and learning.

repos.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆
repos.summary_zh: 影梭（GoGoGo）是一款基于Android调试API和百度地图SDK的虚拟定位工具，无需ROOT权限，适用于Android 8.0+系统。它允许用户自由修改当前位置并通过摇杆控制移动，主要应用于学习Android开发和地图集成技术，亮点在于稳定的定位模拟和直观的交互界面。
repos.summary_en: Shadow Shuttle (GoGoGo) is a virtual positioning tool for Android 8.0+ that uses Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK to enable location modification without ROOT access. It features a joystick for controlled movement, primarily designed for learning Android development and map integration, with highlights in stable location simulation and intuitive UI.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供全球免费代理IP列表，包含HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4和SOCKS5协议，每5分钟更新一次。支持JSON、TXT、CSV格式下载，并提供NPM模块和API接口，适用于爬虫、匿名访问和网络测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Provides a highly reliable, frequently updated list of free HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies from over 140 countries. Updated every 5 minutes, it offers data in JSON, TXT, and CSV formats, along with an NPM module and rotating proxy API for seamless integration into scraping and automation workflows.

repos.description: MoonTV/LunaTV源配置，每日自动检测API状态，可在CF部署CORSAPI中转被墙API，本人提供的CORSAPI仅为测试使用，请勿滥用！
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供MoonTV/LunaTV的多种配置源，包括精简、完整及成人版本，满足不同用户需求。内置基于Cloudflare Workers的CORSAPI代理服务，可中转被墙API并自动添加代理前缀，解决跨域限制。支持Base58编码订阅生成，部署简便，适用于TV应用配置与API代理场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple configuration sources for MoonTV/LunaTV, including simplified, full, and adult versions, to meet diverse user needs. It features a CORSAPI proxy service based on Cloudflare Workers, which can relay blocked APIs and automatically add proxy prefixes, addressing cross-origin restrictions. It supports Base58-encoded subscription generation, with easy deployment, suitable for TV app configuration and API proxy scenarios.

repos.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多平台热点数据的轻量级API接口，支持JSON与RSS格式，提供哔哩哔哩、微博、知乎等数十条热榜数据。响应迅速，部署简便，适用于数据抓取、热点追踪及个性化RSS订阅服务。
repos.summary_en: An aggregated hot trends API supporting JSON and RSS formats, pulling real-time data from major platforms like Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, and Douyin. Lightweight, fast, and easily deployable on Vercel, perfect for developers building custom feeds or tracking viral topics.

repos.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）
repos.summary_zh: 星海音乐源是一款针对LX Music的自定义音源插件，聚合了GDAPI等多平台接口以获取高品质音乐；其核心亮点在于支持通过自建服务器实时解密酷我加密音频，大幅扩展了桌面应用的音乐资源覆盖与播放体验。
repos.summary_en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom music source plugin for LX Music, aggregating APIs from multiple platforms to provide high-quality audio formats. Its key highlight is supporting self-deployed decryption servers to real-time decrypt and play Kuwo's encrypted audio, significantly expanding the music resource coverage and playback experience for desktop applications.

repos.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.
repos.summary_zh: CF Manager 是 Cloudflare 多账号统一管理平台，支持 Workers、DNS、存储及 AI 推理的可视化操作。面向多账号开发者与运维人员，解决账号切换与批量操作痛点。技术亮点包括内置 OpenAI 兼容接口与自托管部署，实现本地调试与数据自主控制。
repos.summary_en: CF Manager is an all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare, enabling visual management of Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference, and browser rendering. It is designed for developers and operators with multiple Cloudflare accounts, solving the pain of account switching and batch operations. Key features include an OpenAI-compatible API for local debugging and self-hosted deployment for full data control.
